title: Vividly Peppery Polish Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring Polish sausage, doubanjiang, and a blend of spices, perfect for a chilly brunch morning. This dish is slow-cooked to bring out the rich flavors of the ingredients.

ingredients.name: Polish sausage
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high meat content

instructions: Slice the Polish sausage into 1-inch thick rounds and set aside.
Chop the onion and mince the garlic, then saute them in a large pot over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the doubanjiang to the pot and stir for 1 minute to release its flavors.
Add the sliced Polish sausage to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Peel and chop the carrots and potatoes, then add them to the pot along with the chicken broth, black pepper, and salt.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Refrigerate or freeze the stew for later use if desired.
